edits.marker: ## Retained consequence can exceed current evaluative use
edits.addition:
## Native effects become an acquired command correspondence

The [next actual continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ACQUIRED-DEPENDENCY-INTEGRATION.md) connects the preceding dependency to acquired command use. Its review first preserves an adequate rival: an informed native rule using available local/source support before bulk copying can meet every feasible initially intact, active-resident count-plus-specified-repair task. Dependence on a future condition therefore does not, by itself, make fresh learning necessary. Which acquired distinction matters also depends on the available controls and unresolved relations.

The new synthetic history supplies two stable command connections that exchange the local and bulk routes. The learner initially lacks their correspondence. From the original material ancestor, two record cells and a finite reader incorporate three A/H pairs. Those six parts remain occupied and unavailable to native copying. Each earlier encounter binds the issued port to a cell, sets aside the writer's support, executes the actual native macro and records its common-fuel effect. Binding and commitment expenditure are excluded from that observed interval. The contact's calibration and functional recipe are declared local laws.

Both training routes restore the same current count. Their retained common-preservation bits differ. Four funded reader operations use those bits to install a port before the later loss sequence. The reader's rule is unchanged across the two physical connections, and it receives neither hidden wiring nor the auditor's native-event names. Its different acquired correspondence selects the route that leaves the final common unit available for the stipulated repair. Knowledge use, material occupation and later response are differentiated relations in this one history.

[Independent reconstruction of twenty fixed cases](../../../experiments/shared-renewal-capability/regulation/retention/formation/learning-interface/recording/continuing-dependency/acquisition/README.md) matches the full ancestry, 4,348 extension records and actual successful or denied repairs. A matched choice clamp keeps the evidence and reading expenditure but fails in the mismatched connection. Inverted records can select the wrong route; incomplete records retain their pending state and writer support. With two common units at the later boundary, either route suffices. No universal preference for one command or necessity of learning is inferred. Each truthful primary history completes one repair and ends with common fuel zero, so this is finite task completion rather than indefinite renewal.

This closes the stated native-effect/record/command composition under the new contact and reader specialization. It learns a port's effect and applies an established repair dependency; it does not acquire that whole dependency law or originate the maintenance purpose. The native reaction form is retained with capacity reduced by occupied memory, not with every former material-78 plant continuation still available. The next connection concerns how access and inquiry arrangements and their undertaking's scope form or are revised through consequences. Their present supplied status is an explanatory limit within the generative account. The [whole-process ethical investigation](UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING.md#the-whole-as-the-grounding-question) continues to address whether and how that continuation is warranted.

edits.marker: ## 2. The actual recipient-evidence, acquired-influence and successor lineage
edits.addition:
## 1a. Native consequences, formed records and continued native repair

The [acquired-dependency continuation](ACQUIRED-DEPENDENCY-INTEGRATION.md) is a **joined synthetic material history under an explicit added contact/reader recipe**. It replays the existing ninety-four-event preparation, incorporates three A/H pairs into two cells and a reader, and then continues native capture/copy/repair with their six occupied parts excluded from precursor capacity. Actual native common depletion determines each port-bound observation; retained bits govern a later command through the same reader rule under both tested connections. No source-to-common teacher kernel or separate initial archive budget is imported.

Independent reconstruction matches all twenty fixed cases, including the full original ancestry, acquired effects, reader expenditure and later successful or denied repair. This closes the particular native-effect/record/use interface identified by the preceding dependency characterization. It remains an alternative descendant of that ancestor, not a splice into the completed low-reserve witness or the distinct recipient-learning lineage below. The finite component's functional capacity, contact calibration, stable wiring, schedule and continuation criterion remain supplied. Earlier record/provenance theorems motivate the design but are not a Lean certification of this extension. The next formation/revision and ethical-grounding obligations remain explicit.

## Subsequent acquired use in a continued material history

The additive [acquisition study](acquisition/README.md) now forms records and a
reader from the original ancestor, retains their occupied material in subsequent
native guards, and uses actual port-bound effects to select a later copy/repair
continuation. Its twenty fixed cases have independent full-state reconstruction.
This supplies a declared contact/reader specialization; it does not retroactively
turn the dependency characterization above into a learner or change its law,
proof scope or preserved results. An informed native rule remains adequate
without acquisition when the relevant action correspondence is already known.
